metadata.chapter: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES

content.title: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES — Sec. 94-163. - Sight distance; minimum requirements.
content.summary:
The following minimum sight distance shall be provided at all access point locations:
Speed
Minimum Sight Distance
45 mph
450 ft.
40 mph
400 ft.
35 mph
350 ft.
30 mph
300 ft.
25 mph
250 ft.
(Code 1981, § 30-148; Ord. No. 1544, § 5(A), 3-19-1979)
